t: The Anatomy of a Reactive UI: An HTMX Case Study
s: This case study demonstrates how HTMX, combined with a local-first server-driven architecture, enables complex, real-time UI interactions, like an intelligently appearing/disappearing 'Reset to Default' button, with minimal client-side JavaScript.
sub: Dynamic button state management with HTMX
Server as the single source of truth for UI state
Progressive enhancement via semantic HTML and HTMX
